question: Which mantra is used when giving only unbroken rice grains?
premises: Only unbroken rice grains are to be given.
The mantra is the means of the offering.
inference: One should give only unbroken rice grains with the mantra beginning 'ākāśāt'.
plain_english: With the mantra beginning 'ākāśāt', one should give only unbroken rice grains.
